name: Fantasy Statblocks Community Templates
description: Community-contributed statblock layouts for systems beyond D&D 5e and Pathfinder 2e. Each template bundles a layout (the visual result) and an example note showing the in-note monster format.

templates.name: Mörk Borg Creature
templates.author: Fantasy Statblocks Community
templates.description: A grim, minimal creature card for Mörk Borg and other OSR doom systems.
requires: Optional: a grim display font installed at OS level for full effect.
Dice Roller plugin (optional) for inline rolls.

templates.name: Mothership Monster
templates.author: Fantasy Statblocks Community
templates.description: Sci-fi horror adversary block with Combat/Instinct, Wounds, Health and Armor.

templates.name: SRD 2024 Statblock
templates.author: Josh Plunkett
templates.description: A faithful Dungeons & Dragons 2024 (SRD 5.2) creature layout — Initiative score, the ability Mod/Save grid, and 2024-style actions, spellcasting, and legendary & lair actions.
requires: Dice Roller plugin (optional) — for inline dice in attacks/saves
Best viewed with the bundled CSS snippet (installed automatically on install)
